purpose: Separate information gained from independent input excitation from the change in vehicle state caused by that excitation.

measurement.target: For each arm, use the unexcited fast-v1 branch's exact state/history, future issued commands, factual truth, and simulator command-response truth at row 150.
measurement.training: Fit a fresh public OnlineFit on each saved control or excited prefix from fast v1 and slow v2, using only completed rows through 150. Predict the common target from its own observed past and future issued commands. Never use target future states or simulator response to fit.
measurement.scope: This is a matched-target diagnostic across separate simulated histories, not a single-flight cold-start Throw result. It tests what each prefix taught the same learner at the same target state. Both vehicle configurations and all source recordings remain development evidence.
